verdict.rationale: Docs show concrete diff-review support (inline diffs in VS Code/JetBrains, 'Review diffs visually' in web UI) and workflow integration for running tests/CI and automated PR code review (GitHub Code Review, running tests as part of workflow). However community feedback raises real caveats: 'You absolutely can't trust it to self-verify' and notes Claude is a better reviewer than implementer, implying pre-merge checks still need human oversight.
